title: emit_campaign_content input (strict variant sent to the model)
description: Strict-compatible variant of ../content.schema.json: identical structure without minLength. Length limits (after personalization) and template-variable rules are enforced only by the backend validator.

body.description: Plain-text SMS template. At most 160 Unicode characters after personalization. Allowed variables: {{first_name}}, {{last_name}}, {{city}}.

subject.description: Plain-text email subject template. At most 80 Unicode characters after personalization.

body.description: Plain-text email body template (no HTML; blank line = new paragraph). The backend renders it to escaped HTML. At most 5000 Unicode characters.
